paragraphs.text: Pontotoc, North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc will meet in the Pontotoc County’s Strongest Powerlifting Invitational on Friday, December 11, at the Pontotoc Agri Center, according to an announcement shared by Pontotoc Athletics.

The Pontotoc Warriors will host the invitational, whose poster names the Warriors, North Pontotoc Vikings and South Pontotoc Cougars as the participating teams. The announcement was shared Tuesday evening, November 17, and identifies the competition date as December 11, 2026.
